initialize_BaseOptions_parser: initialize a BaseOptions instance to set up argparse arguments for hand mocap training and testing
parse_BaseOptions_args: parse command line arguments using BaseOptions.parse to get training config with dataset paths and GPU settings
configure_dataset_paths: configure dataset annotation paths for FreiHand, HO3D, MTC, STB, RHD, and FRL datasets via BaseOptions
set_encoder_architecture: set main and auxiliary encoder models like resnet50 and resnet18 using BaseOptions arguments
configure_SMPLX_model_paths: configure SMPLX model file and hand info paths for 3D hand mesh reconstruction via BaseOptions
